test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_polygon_intersection_shrinking (poly Polygon) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_polygon_intersection_shrinking WITH toFloat64(100 - number * 0.002) AS s SELECT [[(0., 0.), (s, 0.), (s, s), (0., s), (0., 0.)]] FROM numbers(40000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_polygon_intersection_crossbars (p MultiPolygon) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_polygon_intersection_crossbars SELECT arrayMap(i -> [if(number = 0, [(0., 3. * i), (0., 3. * i + 1), (960., 3. * i + 1), (960., 3. * i), (0., 3. * i)], [(3. * i, 0.), (3. * i, 960.), (3. * i + 1, 960.), (3. * i + 1, 0.), (3. * i, 0.)])], range(320)) FROM numbers(2) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_polygon_intersection_holes (id UInt64, separated Polygon, overlapping Polygon) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_polygon_intersection_holes WITH [(0., 0.), (0., 8.), (393220., 8.), (393220., 0.)] AS exterior, arrayRotateLeft(exterior, toInt64(number % 4)) AS shifted SELECT number, [arrayPushBack(shifted, shifted[1]), [(3. * number + 1, 1.), (3. * number + 2, 1.), (3. * number + 2, 2.), (3. * number + 1, 2.), (3. * number + 1, 1.)]], [[(0., 0.), (0., 8.), (393220., 8.), (393220., 0.), (0., 0.)], [(1.5 * number + 1, 1. + number % 2), (1.5 * number + 3, 1. + number % 2), (1.5 * number + 3, 4. + number % 2), (1.5 * number + 1, 4. + number % 2), (1.5 * number + 1, 1. + number % 2)]] FROM numbers(131072) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_polygon_intersection_octagons (p Polygon) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_polygon_intersection_octagons WITH arrayMap(k -> (100 + number * 0.5 + 10 * cos(k * pi() / 4), 500 + 10 * sin(k * pi() / 4)), range(8)) AS h SELECT [[(0., 0.), (0., 5000.), (5000., 5000.), (5000., 0.), (0., 0.)], arrayPushBack(h, h[1])] FROM numbers(8000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(poly) FROM bench_polygon_intersection_shrinking FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(p) FROM bench_polygon_intersection_crossbars FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(separated) FROM bench_polygon_intersection_holes FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonIntersectionMerge(s) FROM (SELECT groupPolygonIntersectionState(separated) AS s FROM bench_polygon_intersection_holes GROUP BY intDiv(id, 32)) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(overlapping) FROM (SELECT id, overlapping FROM bench_polygon_intersection_holes ORDER BY id) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(overlapping) FROM (SELECT id, overlapping FROM bench_polygon_intersection_holes ORDER BY id DESC) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(overlapping) FROM (SELECT id, overlapping FROM bench_polygon_intersection_holes ORDER BY cityHash64(id), id) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(overlapping) FROM (SELECT id, overlapping FROM bench_polygon_intersection_holes ORDER BY id % 2, id) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(overlapping) FROM (SELECT id, overlapping FROM bench_polygon_intersection_holes ORDER BY abs(toInt64(id) - 65536), id) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1

SELECT groupPolygonIntersectionMerge(s) FROM ( SELECT id % 32 AS part, groupPolygonIntersectionState(overlapping) AS s FROM (SELECT id, overlapping FROM bench_polygon_intersection_holes ORDER BY cityHash64(id), id) GROUP BY part ORDER BY cityHash64(part), part ) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonIntersection(p) FROM bench_polygon_intersection_octagons FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
